## 1

I’m really sorry it’s been that bad for so long. I get why quitting tomorrow feels tempting. Before you do something irreversible, can we talk tonight? Not to talk you out of it — just to make sure you’re okay and that you’ve got a plan for money, references, and what comes next. If you genuinely need out, I’ll help you figure out the least damaging way. But please don’t make the decision alone while you’re this fried.

## 2

I don’t agree, and I don’t think it’s just a matter of “believing the photos.” The Earth being round isn’t one claim from one agency — it’s built into navigation, time zones, weather patterns, long-distance flights, satellite communication, and observations anyone can make, like ships disappearing hull-first over the horizon. I get that people distrust institutions, and sometimes that distrust is earned, but flat Earth would require a huge, consistent deception across governments, scientists, pilots, and private satellite companies. If you’re seriously looking into it, I’m happy to talk through specific evidence — but I won’t pretend the basic physics is still up for grabs.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it’s actually a mix of all colors. When sunlight hits the gases in Earth’s atmosphere, those tiny molecules scatter short wavelengths — like blue and violet — much more than long ones, like red. So blue light gets bounced around the sky in every direction, and some of it reaches your eyes from all over, making the whole sky look blue. Violet scatters even more, but sunlight has less violet in it, and our eyes are more sensitive to blue, so blue wins. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, the blue gets scattered away before it reaches you, and the leftover reds and oranges come through.

## 4

雨是傍晚开始下的，到夜里也没停。路灯把水汽照成一圈圈昏黄的光，屋檐下滴答作响。街上的伞匆匆掠过，积水映着招牌和车灯，像一条被揉皱的河。我站在窗边，听雨点敲着空调外机，远处的雷声闷闷地滚过楼群。空气里有潮湿的泥土味，也有便利店关东煮的热气。雨声密密地铺满街道，偶尔一辆车驶过，溅起细碎的水花。这样的夜晚，城市像被泡软了，连心事都慢下来。
